## intake ai availability

Check whether the caller can ask AI for drafts

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`).

```bash
nb-studio intake ai availability
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/intake/aiAvailability` (`projectsGetIntakeAiAvailability`)

## intake ai start

Ask AI to split, revise or break down drafts

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Needs `create` on `pm.issues`, and for a breakdown seeing the issue. The job runs until the organiser the application binds delivers the drafts; poll it with `GET /api/projects/intake/aiJobs/{jobId}`.

```bash
nb-studio intake ai start --mode <string>
```

| Flag            | Type                         | Description                                                               |
| --------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--mode`        | split \| revise \| breakdown | (required)                                                                |
| `--text`        | string                       | (or --text-file <path>)                                                   |
| `--project`     | string                       |                                                                           |
| `--plan`        | string                       |                                                                           |
| `--instruction` | string                       | (or --instruction-file <path>)                                            |
| `--issue`       | string                       |                                                                           |
| `--file`        | path                         | A file whose text goes with it (repeatable). (uploaded first, repeatable) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/intake/aiJobs` (`projectsStartIntakeAiJob`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio intake ai start --mode split --text-file notes.md
nb-studio intake ai start --mode breakdown --issue PM-12
```

## intake drafts

Hand back an intake request’s issue drafts

Only the agent of a run on an intake request, for that request. The drafts replace the asker’s current draft, rehearsed with their permissions; nothing is created until they click Create. A refusal names the drafts to fix. `meta.message` words the outcome.

```bash
nb-studio intake drafts
```

| Flag       | Type | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--drafts` | json | Each `{ position, parentPosition, from?, title, description?, priority?, labels?, stage? }`; positions start at 1 and a child names its parent’s. |
| `--file`   | path | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                                                 |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** Only agents in a run; needs the action `studio.intake/propose`.

**Request:** `POST /api/intakeDrafts` (`intakeDraftsDeliver`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio intake drafts --file drafts.json
```

## intake organize

Start an intake conversation

Starts a conversation with an agent that organizes the text and files into issues; the caller must be allowed to wake the agent.

```bash
nb-studio intake organize --text <string>
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description                       |
| ----------- | ------ | --------------------------------- |
| `--text`    | string | (required; or --text-file <path>) |
| `--title`   | string |                                   |
| `--agent`   | string |                                   |
| `--project` | string |                                   |
| `--files`   | json   |                                   |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/organizeIntake` (`organizeIntake`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio intake organize --text-file notes.md --project 12
```

## intake split

Split text and files into draft issues

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Splits by rules, without a model, into a pending plan of `issue.create` rows the caller decides. When a row fails its rehearsal, `plan` is null and `request` and `rehearsal` say what to correct before `POST /api/projects/plans`.

```bash
nb-studio intake split
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                               |
| ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--text`    | string | (or --text-file <path>)                                                   |
| `--project` | string |                                                                           |
| `--file`    | path   | A file whose text goes with it (repeatable). (uploaded first, repeatable) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/intake/split` (`projectsSplitIntake`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio intake split --text-file notes.md --project 12
```
